subject: Include stddef in zmalloc.h (#516)
reason: The change only adds #include <stddef.h> to zmalloc.h so the header compiles standalone (size_t is otherwise undeclared when zmalloc.h is included first). It is a build-time header fix with no runtime behaviour change: no command, reply, memory-allocation semantics, replication or persistence path differs between the two builds, so no fuzzer scenario can observe it.
